This is a brilliant tactical blow: a knight fork/check that forces the king into a mating net.

**Coaching note for the 1500-rated player:**

When your opponent's king is near the back rank with limited escape squares, look for forcing moves (checks and captures) that drive the king into a corner. After Nxf3+, forcing Kh1, the h-pawn delivers mate by controlling g1. Your loose knight wasn't a weakness—it was bait for a devastating tactical blow. Always calculate forcing sequences fully before moving.
